label: Sampler
notes: The seed picks a whole combination from the kit, unbred: a heavy voice (a drift, a hand or a dance, with a field, a tempo or prosody for weight, in nib or line-built ink), a dry wire voice, and sometimes a third (its own measurement, or a dance). Ian, round 10: "some golden ones here" and "curiously I dig the unbred ones more". The sample space is every generative hand, dance and tempo in the frozen library, so hands learned later enter it after a refreeze; a kept layer stores the combination it drew, so a refreeze never changes it. Save as new study keeps the combination as a study of its own.
